title: Shared popover hit-test's new pipe leg is inert in the harness — no scripted scenario can reach it
detail: Verified: no scripted scenario can take the newly added pipe leg, so no existing golden shifts — but the leg is the one unpinned surface of the new shared code; a future break there would pass input-parity silently.
recommended_fix: When the demolish surface gains pins, add a scenario that click-selects the pipe (press+release mid01), presses its demolish-button center, and asserts Cmd_Demolish_Pipe + cleared selection — the pipe twin of the esc_ui pin.
